name: Label
description: The accessible name for a form control — always tied to it by id.

htmlFor.description: The id of the control this labels. Always set it.

forbidden: Do not leave a Label unassociated — always set htmlFor to the control's id.
Do not use Label as generic text; use Text or Eyebrow for non-control labels.
Do not restyle size/weight via className; it's a fixed token style.

responsive.note: Interactive targets should remain at least 44px. Layouts should fit parent width without horizontal overflow on mobile.
